RuleCall.description: One call into the engine's vocabulary: what is called, and what it is called with.

name.description: Exact name of the call, as the vocabulary below spells it.
name.title: Name

args.description: Its arguments: exactly the keys the vocabulary lists under that name, and no others. Empty when every argument sits at its default.
args.title: Args

RuleCall.title: RuleCall

description: How the turn is framed, and its first beat.

roll.description: The one thing this beat puts to the dice, or null when nothing that happens is uncertain enough to roll.

effects.description: What this beat causes in the world, applied once the roll has settled. Empty when nothing changes.
effects.title: Effects

focus.description: 1-2 sentences: what the player is reaching for and what this turn is about.
focus.title: Focus

speaker_id.description: Exact id of the NPC the player addresses — one they have met and who is here with them — or null if nobody is addressed.
speaker_id.title: Speaker Id
